sub_agent_reviews.summary: Single merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training and ai-safety; duplicate pivots rejected ToolPrivBench, NRT-Bench, VIMPO, slime and Defensive Misdirection before selecting Calibration Without Comprehension.
Main agent read the arXiv abstract, PDF and HTML text, extracting CWE-Trace construction, DFI/HDD metrics, LoRA setup, contamination audit, detection results and limitations.
Article is pure Markdown with tables, formulas, pseudocode and Mermaid; no external image URLs are embedded.
